name: io.moderne.devcenter.ClassCohesionDevCenter
description:
A DevCenter that grades the maintainability, cohesion, and test gaps of each repository, based on the class quality metrics and test gaps computed by Moderne Prethink. **Average Class Maintainability**
The maintainability index (0-100) averaged across all classes in each repository.

`F` (0+) → `D` (20+) → `C` (40+) → `B` (60+) → `A` (80+) **Average Class Cohesion**
LCOM4 (Lack of Cohesion of Methods, version 4) averaged across all classes in each repository; lower is more cohesive.

`LOW` (10+) → `MEDIUM` (3+) → `HIGH` (0+) **Test Gaps Risk**
The risk scores of public, non-trivial methods without tests, summed per repository.

`LOW` (0+) → `MEDIUM` (3+) → `HIGH` (10+) The DevCenter also counts lines of code per repository and committers active in the last 90 days. See the [DevCenter documentation](https://docs.moderne.io/administrator-documentation/moderne-platform/how-to-guides/recipe-based-devcenter/) to customize.

name: io.moderne.devcenter.QuarkusDevCenter
description:
A DevCenter that tracks the latest Quarkus framework versions and applies best practices. This DevCenter includes recipes to upgrade Quarkus versions, migrate from deprecated APIs, and ensure compatibility with the latest Java versions. **Move to Quarkus 4.0**
The lowest version of any `io.quarkus:quarkus-*` dependency in each repository, compared to 4.0.x.

`Major` → `Minor` → `Patch` → `Completed` · fix with [`MigrateToQuarkus_v4_0_0`](https://codegenomeproject.org/recipes/org.openrewrite.quarkus.MigrateToQuarkus_v4_0_0) **Move to the latest Quarkus Universe BOM**
The version of the `io.quarkus:quarkus-universe-bom` parent POM, compared to 4.0.x.

`Major` → `Minor` → `Patch` → `Completed` · fix with [`UpgradeQuarkusUniverseBom`](https://codegenomeproject.org/recipes/io.moderne.devcenter.UpgradeQuarkusUniverseBom) **Move to Java 25**
The Java version each repository compiles for.

`Java 8+` → `Java 11+` → `Java 17+` → `Java 21+` → `Completed` · fix with [`UpgradeToJava25`](https://codegenomeproject.org/recipes/org.openrewrite.java.migrate.UpgradeToJava25) **OWASP top ten**
Issue occurrences per category, counted across all repositories.

`A01 Broken access control` · `A02 Cryptographic failures` · `A03 Injection` · `A08 Software and data integrity failures` · fix with [`OwaspTopTen`](https://codegenomeproject.org/recipes/org.openrewrite.java.security.OwaspTopTen) The DevCenter also counts lines of code per repository and committers active in the last 90 days. See the [DevCenter documentation](https://docs.moderne.io/administrator-documentation/moderne-platform/how-to-guides/recipe-based-devcenter/) to customize.

name: io.moderne.devcenter.VulnerabilitiesByEcosystemDevCenter
displayName: DevCenter for Vulnerability Management by ecosystem
description:
Track and fix vulnerable dependencies separately for each package ecosystem: Java (Maven and Gradle), npm, PyPI, and NuGet. Each card looks at known vulnerabilities with an available fix, and its fix action runs that ecosystem's own vulnerability remediation recipe. Copy this recipe to your own repository to drop ecosystems you don't use or rename the cards. Remove an ecosystem's check and its cards together. **Java vulnerabilities by Severity**
The most severe vulnerability in the Maven and Gradle dependencies of each repository.

`Critical` → `High` → `Moderate` → `Low` → `No fixable vulnerabilities` · fix with [`DependencyVulnerabilityCheck`](https://codegenomeproject.org/recipes/org.openrewrite.java.dependencies.DependencyVulnerabilityCheck) **Java vulnerabilities by UpgradeDelta**
The largest version bump needed to fix the vulnerable Maven and Gradle dependencies in each repository.

`Major` → `Minor` → `Patch` → `No vulnerabilities` · fix with [`DependencyVulnerabilityCheck`](https://codegenomeproject.org/recipes/org.openrewrite.java.dependencies.DependencyVulnerabilityCheck) **Java vulnerabilities by RiskScore**
The highest EPSS score, the probability of exploitation in the next 30 days, in the Maven and Gradle dependencies of each repository.

`Critical` (>50%) → `High` (10-50%) → `Medium` (1-10%) → `Low` (<1%) → `No vulnerability scores` · fix with [`DependencyVulnerabilityCheck`](https://codegenomeproject.org/recipes/org.openrewrite.java.dependencies.DependencyVulnerabilityCheck) **npm vulnerabilities by Severity**
The most severe vulnerability in the npm dependencies of each repository.

`Critical` → `High` → `Moderate` → `Low` → `No fixable vulnerabilities` · fix with [`DependencyVulnerabilityCheck`](https://codegenomeproject.org/recipes/org.openrewrite.nodejs.security.DependencyVulnerabilityCheck) **npm vulnerabilities by UpgradeDelta**
The largest version bump needed to fix the vulnerable npm dependencies in each repository.

`Major` → `Minor` → `Patch` → `No vulnerabilities` · fix with [`DependencyVulnerabilityCheck`](https://codegenomeproject.org/recipes/org.openrewrite.nodejs.security.DependencyVulnerabilityCheck) **PyPI vulnerabilities by Severity**
The most severe vulnerability in the PyPI dependencies of each repository.

`Critical` → `High` → `Moderate` → `Low` → `No fixable vulnerabilities` · fix with [`DependencyVulnerabilityCheck`](https://codegenomeproject.org/recipes/org.openrewrite.python.dependencies.DependencyVulnerabilityCheck) **PyPI vulnerabilities by UpgradeDelta**
The largest version bump needed to fix the vulnerable PyPI dependencies in each repository.

`Major` → `Minor` → `Patch` → `No vulnerabilities` · fix with [`DependencyVulnerabilityCheck`](https://codegenomeproject.org/recipes/org.openrewrite.python.dependencies.DependencyVulnerabilityCheck) **NuGet vulnerabilities by Severity**
The most severe vulnerability in the NuGet dependencies of each repository.

`Critical` → `High` → `Moderate` → `Low` → `No fixable vulnerabilities` · fix with [`DependencyVulnerabilityCheck`](https://codegenomeproject.org/recipes/org.openrewrite.csharp.dependencies.DependencyVulnerabilityCheck) **NuGet vulnerabilities by UpgradeDelta**
The largest version bump needed to fix the vulnerable NuGet dependencies in each repository.

`Major` → `Minor` → `Patch` → `No vulnerabilities` · fix with [`DependencyVulnerabilityCheck`](https://codegenomeproject.org/recipes/org.openrewrite.csharp.dependencies.DependencyVulnerabilityCheck) The DevCenter also counts lines of code per repository and committers active in the last 90 days. See the [DevCenter documentation](https://docs.moderne.io/administrator-documentation/moderne-platform/how-to-guides/recipe-based-devcenter/) to customize.
